_meta.description: DPE 2021 label thresholds (A-G). Final label = worst of the energy (primary energy) and climate (CO2) classifications. Upper bounds are exclusive ('Cep < 70' => class A), values compared after rounding down to integer per the annexe.
_meta.source: Annexe 5 de l'arrêté du 31 mars 2021 relatif au DPE pour les bâtiments à usage d'habitation (JORFTEXT000043353335), version consolidée publiée sur rt-re-batiment.developpement-durable.gouv.fr (consolide_annexes_arrete_du_31_03_2021_relatif_au_dpe_habitation.pdf, pages 11-12), transcription verbatim.
_meta.notes: The 'high_altitude_cold_zones' variant applies to dwellings in zones H1b, H1c, H2d above 800 m: classes E, F and G get relaxed bounds; A-D are unchanged. The arrêté du 25 mars 2024 (JORFTEXT000049446315) introduces surface-dependent thresholds for dwellings <= 40 m2; NOT encoded in V1 (documented deviation, see docs/deviations.md).
